rationale: The full-context MAA notice states its current position, says a certified-air-system applicant should raise an MCRI for MAA agreement, and recommends fixed supervised models within a defined ODD for early safety-related applications. The claim preserves the applicant-specific, UK-military character and does not turn a recommendation into civil approval or a public product case.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-001-R1, MAA/RN/2025/04, PDF pp. 1-2, Scope, Implementation and Background
S-CHAL-001-R2, MAA/RN/2025/04, PDF pp. 2-3, Certified Air Systems
limitations: The notice is informative UK military guidance; the package has no underlying MMAC/MCRI or completed public MCRI.
It cannot establish FAA/EASA civil-airworthiness acceptance or a particular system's safety.
